operations.body: Local finding 2026-09-15: on macOS 26.6.2 (Darwin 25), electron-builder 26's DMG step fails in the bundled dmgbuild (plistlib.InvalidFileException while parsing hdiutil output; dmg-builder@1.2.5). The .app and ZIP targets build and the ad-hoc signature verifies. CI's macOS runner may not hit this; if it does, the DMG target needs a newer dmg-builder or a different hdiutil invocation before the macOS update flow (which downloads the DMG) can work.
